scope: Fixture assertions and missing qualification, not a record that these scenarios passed on an adapter. Acceptance thresholds remain in the owning fixtures.
execution: serial per profile; shared CI/local runner; all GPU environment gates explicit

scenarios.qualification_gap: Diverse representative quality and native-source reference contributor parity are not established by tiny images.

fractional descriptor and image endpoint gates
orthographic lateral pan preserves image under exact pixel translation and byte-identical return
gps_contracts: current-camera image while diagnostic feedback is paused
current-camera fallback while atlas uploads wait
scenarios.qualification_gap: Matched full-scene moving detail, visual quality and delivered-frame latency still require captured routes.

ordered_contracts: two pure camera yaw poses match explicitly far-to-near flat reference streams
shared_contracts: transformed-bound CPU/GPU cut parity; flat cameras switch opposing views
scenarios.qualification_gap: Two flat yaw poses are not continuous hierarchy-consumer rotation or GPS rotation image qualification.

ordered_contracts: tiny orthographic zoom at fixed resident spatial cut
scenarios.qualification_gap: Perspective focal zoom and GPS zoom image sequences remain unqualified; axial motion is a separate case.

separate fixed resident spatial cut approaches the exact child endpoint across the conservative near envelope
gps_contracts: current-camera near-plane opacity approach and crossing with perspective and orthographic projections
shared_contracts: ordinary quads, ordered quads and fixed-seed eight-sample GPS use six approach/cross/return depths in both projections; exact return and bounded near-image peaks; no hierarchy inputs
near support versus thin transformed AABB
near descendant admission and complete missing-cohort fallback
scenarios.qualification_gap: Tiny near-clipping and fixed-cut spatial assertions do not establish near-camera quality of authored proxies, changing residency, or cold missing-cohort recovery. GPS has no spatial-morph coverage.

ordered_contracts: returned fully resident perspective spatial pose equals baseline
gps_contracts: returned package camera has a nonempty acknowledged image
scenarios.qualification_gap: GPS return phase does not assert exact image equality. Long-route reverse-camera detail and image recovery under changing residency remain separate gates.

ordered_contracts: cold CPU-discrete and GPU package activation
gps_contracts: identical frozen sampling after atlas relocation
scenarios.qualification_gap: Atlas relocation and cold startup are not a cold camera teleport. Neither backend has a bounded distant-teleport image/detail recovery gate here.

shared_contracts: desired cut independent of page arrival
scenarios.qualification_gap: Steady cache churn and parent/child working sets on a long route require measured images and residency recovery; work overflow is not cache-pressure qualification.

shared_contracts: six flat camera views across sort modes, opposing depth order, capacity retention and camera removal
hidden-record rejection at 16/24/32-bit radix precision and CPU-sort parity
scenarios.qualification_gap: The ordered/GPS fixtures have multiple clouds in one view. Concurrent hierarchy-consumer views with independent camera motion and shared package demand are not qualified by the flat sorter fixture.

unsupported_combinations: GPS does not consume ordered spatial morph output; no spatial continuity acceptance is inherited.
The native core fixture matrix does not establish browser execution or portable-adapter image parity.

capture_pairing.scope: Strict pairing is opt-in for intentionally sampled captures. Multiview receipts require unambiguous run/view identity; paired images require identical camera and source/path identity. Output always remains teacher-relative and release_qualified=false.
capture_pairing.config_limits: Synthetic route is the CPU hierarchy consumer; Poland config is one ordered SH0 held pose requiring external data. Neither config supplies the entire scenario matrix.
